A1.justification: Both PDFs describe PaceLLM. Their complete main texts, figures, tables, equations and appendices support reliable comparison, including matching material relocated in v2.

before.justification: v1 reports original LongBench, ∞-Bench, NIAH and MMLU evaluations, component ablations, activation visualizations and inference-time measurements.

after.justification: v2 retains these empirical results and adds a PA-only comparison and evaluations on two additional model configurations.

M1.justification: The PA memory-bank retrieval, fusion and update rules, CE clustering and weight reordering, and Algorithms 1–2 remain unchanged. The added CAMELoT comparison describes positioning without introducing a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same LongBench, ∞-Bench, NIAH and MMLU coverage. Appendix E adds model configurations within the retained LongBench tasks, without introducing new datasets, domains or test scenarios.

E2.justification: Table 2 adds Activation Beacon + PA to the fine-tuning comparison, retaining all previous comparators. Table 9 includes unmodified Qwen2.5-14B and Llama-3.1-8B references for the added evaluations. CAMELoT is discussed but not experimentally compared.

E3.justification: Appendix E extends training-free evaluation from the existing 7B configurations to Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Previously stated experimental settings, including memory parameters and the fine-tuning setup, are retained.

E4.justification: The new Activation Beacon + PA row in Table 2 isolates PA's contribution without CE in the fine-tuning setting, completing a previously missing component comparison. The layer-placement, threshold and noise ablations, efficiency analysis and activation visualization remain unchanged.

E5.justification: New checklist item 7 discusses repeated-run variability by asserting deterministic outputs under identical configurations and arguing that multiple runs are unnecessary. This adds a reporting rationale, but no run counts, seeds, error bars, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: Existing result entries are retained. Table 2 adds AB+PA scores of 41.10/42.80/27.90/69.31/67.51 for SQA/MQA/Sum./FSL/Code; Table 9 adds two models' baseline and PaceLLM results across five categories. The new Llama discussion misidentifies the largest gains: code increases by 1.15, exceeding MQA's 0.76 and summarization's 0.26.

T1.justification: Equations 1–20 and the mathematical formulations of constrained clustering and LRU memory management in Appendix D are unchanged. No new formal assumptions, theoretical results, derivations or proofs are introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims: activation-level memory, cortical clustering, model-agnostic integration, benchmark gains and 200K-token retrieval. The additional model evaluations support the existing generalization claim rather than redefine it.

C2.justification: Appendix E newly interprets model-specific gains as better use of contextual demonstrations and compensation for long-context integration limitations. Section 3.2.1 adds a claimed semantic-retention distinction from CAMELoT. The existing computation and storage limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 identifies Fudan's CFFF computing platform and adds checklist promises to release code, data and documentation upon acceptance. It provides no PaceLLM access link establishing an actual release. Existing hardware, hyperparameters and implementation descriptions are retained.

R1.justification: v2 adds Geva et al.'s work on FFNs as key-value memories and the CAMELoT reference. Sections 2.1 and 3.2.1 respectively acknowledge this FFN interpretation and contrast memory-management approaches; the broader research positioning is retained.

P1.justification: v2 adds brief related-work and method passages, acknowledgments and a NeurIPS checklist, and renames and expands Appendix E. The main narrative and technical appendix organization otherwise remain largely intact; there is no extensive rewrite.

P2.justification: v2 adds Table 9, expands Table 2 with one row, revises Table 8's caption and moves Table 5 from page 8 to page 9. Existing figures retain their content, with limited table-formatting and page-layout adjustments.

improvement.justification: Table 2 fills a missing PA-only component comparison, while Table 9 modestly strengthens evidence across model configurations and the added references improve attribution. These benefits outweigh the localized misstatement about Llama's largest gains. The central method remains unchanged, and the checklist adds no measured uncertainty, so the overall improvement is limited.
